description: Each village council's people, drinking water, MGNREGA works and money
summary: This page shows the gram panchayats (village councils) in this district: population, households, drinking water coverage, road connectivity, MGNREGA works, and the money each panchayat was given and has used, from eGramSwaraj and NREGA.nic.in. Amounts are shown in lakh or crore rupees (1 lakh = ₹1,00,000; 1 crore = 100 lakh).
urbanBody: {district} is a fully urban district governed by a Municipal Corporation. Gram Panchayat and MGNREGA data applies only to rural areas.

urbanSource: Data sourced from the District NIC portal and the Municipal Corporation website.
